Patient Information Sheets

Evidence-based home programmes and self-management guides from Dr Ron Granot at East Neurology.

These sheets are written for my own patients at East Neurology. Each one is a practical, evidence-based programme you can start at home, on your own, today.

They are a starting point, not a substitute for the assessment and advice you receive in the consulting room. If something on these pages does not fit what you have been told about your own condition, what you have been told takes priority.

Balance and falls

Balance & falls preventionA home programme to steady your balance and reduce your risk of falling — no equipment, no gym, ten to twenty minutes a day. Neuropathy & myopathy balanceA home programme for imbalance caused by peripheral neuropathy or muscle disease — training the senses that still work, and the muscles that still respond. Dizziness & vestibular exercisesExercises that retrain the balance organ of the inner ear — for dizziness, unsteadiness and the sense that the world moves when you do. Parkinson's exercise programmeA comprehensive home programme — big movements, fast movements, hard aerobic work and balance training — built on the principles behind PD Warrior and LSVT BIG.

Sleep and stress

InsomniaWhat actually works for persistent insomnia — the behavioural treatment that outperforms sleeping tablets, relaxation techniques, sleep hygiene, daytime activity and pain control.

Spine

Back pain & coreA static, spine-sparing core programme built on holds rather than sit-ups — plus the daily habits that decide whether back pain keeps coming back. Neck pain & ergonomicsHow to set up your desk, phone, car and pillow — and a short daily programme of gentle neck and shoulder-blade exercises that has good evidence behind it.
